repository_layout.tracked_source: git archive of the requested commit

external_kernel.availability: operator-supplied; this repository has no download locator
external_kernel.identity_algorithm: sha256 over sorted Python source paths and bytes as path NUL bytes NUL

system_dependencies.pdftotext: optional live PDF extraction path; missing binary is a recorded bounded failure
system_dependencies.playwright_chromium: required only for browser-marked validation; install with playwright install chromium
system_dependencies.postgresql: required only for DB-marked legacy tests; absent service is reported as skipped
